verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws: the background is cropped to a blurry, washed-out fragment of the interior with no recognisable furniture, so the original's key imagery is effectively lost. 'COPENHAGEN' runs almost to the right canvas edge, the headline sits over busy shelving behind 'FURNITURE/DESIGN', and the info boxes don't share the headline's left edge. A also floats the black box apart from the blue one with a loose gap near the bottom, which scatters the info group. B keeps the two boxes stacked and offset as in the original, so it groups and reads better, though it leaves a slightly larger empty band at the bottom.
